name: @brainmux/graphmux
description: Local, deterministic codebase memory (call-graph MCP) for Claude Code and bmux delegates — thin wrapper over the vendored CodeGraph core.

scripts.prepare: npm run build && npm run bundle
scripts.dist-check: npm run bundle && git diff --exit-code -- dist/gmux.js
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run bundle && node --test "dist/test/**/*.test.js"
